description:
Job Summary

Web3Box Software LLC is seeking a Software Developer to contribute to the design, development, testing, and ongoing improvement of web\-based software applications.

Web3Box develops custom web platforms, mobile applications, AI\-enhanced systems, and other digital solutions for businesses across industries including healthcare, education, legal services, and B2B SaaS. The Software Developer will collaborate with engineers and other project team members to translate business and technical requirements into reliable, maintainable software.

The ideal candidate has a solid understanding of modern web development, enjoys solving technical problems, and can communicate effectively while working on multiple stages of the software development lifecycle.

Responsibilities

* Design, develop, test, and maintain web application features.
* Write clean, maintainable, and well\-documented code.
* Work on front\-end and back\-end application functionality based on project requirements.
* Collaborate with developers, designers, and project stakeholders.
* Translate functional requirements and designs into working software.
* Troubleshoot application issues and identify practical solutions.
* Participate in code reviews, testing, debugging, and quality assurance.
* Work with databases, APIs, and third\-party integrations.
* Assist with improvements to existing applications and legacy systems.
* Support application performance, security, reliability, and scalability.

* Ability to troubleshoot technical issues and work through problems systematically.
* Ability to write organized and maintainable code.
* Strong attention to detail and commitment to software quality.
* Good written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to collaborate effectively with technical and nontechnical team members.
* Ability to manage priorities and meet project deadlines.

Preferred Qualifications

* Experience with Laravel, Vue, React, or similar technologies.
* Experience developing custom web applications or SaaS products.
* Familiarity with mobile or cross\-platform application development, including React Native.
* Experience integrating third\-party APIs and external services.

Benefits

**Employer verification required before posting.** Add only benefits Web3Box actually provides to employees in this position, such as:

* Health insurance, if offered
* Dental and vision insurance, if offered
* Paid time off, if offered
* Retirement benefits, if offered

Do not advertise a benefit until Web3Box confirms that employees in this position are eligible for it.

Why Join Web3Box?

Web3Box has more than 20 years of software development experience and reports serving more than 250 clients with a team of over 25 professionals across the United States and Europe.

The company's work spans custom web applications, mobile and hybrid applications, AI\-enhanced systems, hosting and ongoing support, and technology consulting. title: Lead Field Technician — IT, Low Voltage & AV
description:
Company Overview

Space Cadets is a growing managed IT service provider in the greater San Francisco Bay Area. We deliver a wider range of solutions than most MSPs — managed IT, networking, cybersecurity, and a low\-voltage and audio/visual practice that few of our competitors can match. We are also evaluating AI and automation services for our clients. Our commitment to honest guidance and quality execution is what sets us apart.

Our Core Values

Our core values ensure we are always doing the right thing for Space Cadets as well as our clients:

· **Honest Communication \& Listening:** We provide honest guidance and are transparent about our pricing, ensuring we address client needs, challenges, and questions.

· **Challenging Collaboration:** We execute as one team, including our customers, striving for improvement and soliciting honest perspectives.

· **Constant Curiosity:** Asking questions is at the core of our growth — when we don't know something, we say so, then go figure it out.

· **Applied Learning:** Knowledge in application is how we grow and improve — what we learn on one job shows up in how we run the next.

· **Intelligent Analysis:** We look before we leap — evaluate the options, understand the trade\-offs, and recommend what actually makes sense.

· **Ethics \& Integrity:** We are honest brokers, focusing on solutions that position clients for success.

· **Wit \& Joy:** We make the work environment vibrant and enjoyable.

Position Description

We are looking for a senior field engineer to lead the execution of our low\-voltage, AV, and network projects. You will run jobs on\-site from kickoff to closeout, coordinate technicians and subcontractor crews, and be the person we trust to deliver.

Between field days, you are the primary technical resource for our managed services clients — tickets come to you directly and you own them through resolution, alongside the back\-office work that keeps projects moving. This is a hands\-on role for someone who wants ownership of the whole picture rather than a narrow lane.

This is the role that lets our team scale beyond a single set of hands, and it comes with real ownership and room to grow as we build out the field organization.

This is not an entry\-level or early\-career role — if you don't have at least 5 years of hands\-on field/IT work including 3\+ in an MSP environment, this isn't the right fit yet.

Responsibilities

**Project Execution:** Own on\-site execution of designed projects — scheduling, materials and staging, sequencing, and quality control from kickoff to closeout.

**Site Leadership:** Coordinate field technicians (including 1099/on\-call techs) and subcontractor crews (e.g., structured\-cabling partners) on the job site — sequencing their work and keeping quality consistent.

**Help Desk \& Remote Support:** Act as the primary technical resource on our managed services queue between field days — take tickets directly, troubleshoot and resolve remotely across Windows and macOS, work the queue in HaloPSA, and support end users professionally and thoroughly.

**Audio / Visual:** Install and configure Sonos audio, conferencing/AV systems, displays, and high\-end TVs (LG, Samsung).

**Networking:** Deploy and configure UniFi (our standard) and Cisco Meraki (higher\-end) — routers, firewalls, wireless access points, VLANs, DNS, and DHCP.

**Security \& Low\-Voltage:** Install and support security cameras (UniFi Protect, Verkada, and similar), door access control systems, and structured cabling.

**Back\-Office Technical:** Pre\-stage and configure equipment, perform Microsoft 365 / Entra / Intune administration, and document thoroughly in HaloPSA.

**Client Interaction:** Represent Space Cadets professionally on\-site, and report project status, risks, and change\-order needs back to the owner.

Practical AI in Day\-to\-Day Operations

We use AI and automation in our own day\-to\-day operations — documentation, knowledge management, and service delivery. A small operation is a good place to learn the practical application of these tools: you see how they actually get used on real work, and you have room to put them to use yourself.

A Note on the Field Work

When there's on\-site work, it's physical. You'll work in drop\-tile ceilings, attics, and crawl spaces. You'll spend time on ladders and occasionally work on rooftops. You'll drill through walls, pull cable through tight spaces, and mount equipment overhead. You'll lift and carry equipment up to 50 lbs. If that sounds like a good day at work to you, keep reading.

Minimum Qualifications

· At least 5 years in field/low\-voltage and IT work, including at least 3 years in a managed service provider (MSP) or similar technology\-services environment.

· Demonstrated experience running installations on\-site and coordinating technicians and subcontractor crews.

· Hands\-on depth across audio/visual, networking, and low\-voltage/security installation.

· Proven help desk or end\-user support capability — comfortable owning tickets end to end, not just project work.

· Proficiency with Microsoft 365 (Entra/Azure AD, Intune, Teams, SharePoint, OneDrive).

· Strong networking fundamentals — configuring routers, firewalls, wireless access points, VLANs, DNS, and DHCP.

· Experience providing technical support across both Windows and macOS environments.

· Valid driver's license and **your own reliable vehicle** — you'll drive to client sites across the Bay Area (mileage reimbursed for job\-site travel).

· Excellent communication, organization, and troubleshooting skills; takes ownership of assigned work and operates proactively.

We don't expect deep mastery of every item above — if you're strong across most of these and ready to grow into the rest, apply.

Preferred Certifications \& Experience

· CompTIA Network\+ and/or Security\+ certification.

· Manufacturer certifications such as Ubiquiti/UniFi (any UniFi certification track), Sonos, Crestron or Control4, and Verkada, OpenPath or Avigilon (or similar camera and access control platforms).

· BICSI Installer or Technician certification (or working toward one).

· OSHA 10 or equivalent jobsite safety training (a plus, not required).

· Low\-voltage license or licensed contractor experience.

· Familiarity with NinjaRMM (or similar RMM), HaloPSA (or similar PSA), and SentinelOne (or similar EDR/XDR).

· Knowledge of ITIL principles and PSA\-based ticketing and documentation.

· Google Workspace administration experience.

Compensation

· Competitive annual salary, depending on experience and skillset.

· Full\-time, W\-2 employee position.

· Mileage reimbursement for travel to and from job and vendor sites.

· Company\-provided laptop, software licenses, and field tools.

· We'll fund manufacturer certifications relevant to your work — UniFi, Verkada, Crestron/Control4, and similar.

What to Expect

· A mix of on\-site field work across the Bay Area and remote support between field days — the balance shifts with project load.

· Occasional advance\-noticed off\-hours or out\-of\-town work for client onboardings.

· Participation in an on\-call rotation.

· A wide range of project types — most MSPs don't touch the low\-voltage and AV work we do.

Why Join Space Cadets

· Real project ownership — kickoff to closeout — plus the trust to run our support queue as the senior technical voice, not a ticket\-closing seat on someone else's team.

· Unusually broad exposure — managed IT, networking, security, AV, low\-voltage, and emerging AI/automation work.

· Direct access to the founder. You'll learn faster here than buried in a large org.

· As the field org grows past one lead, you're the person whose fingerprints are on how it's built — how jobs get run, how techs get onboarded, what "done right" looks like here. That's not available at a 200\-person MSP.

· We take pride in clean cable management, labeled runs, documented configurations, and leaving client sites better than we found them. If you care about doing the job right — not just getting it done — you'll fit in.

How to Apply

Send your resume and a short cover letter to **careers@space\-cadets.co** telling us why you're the right person to lead our project execution.

Tell us:

1\. What's the most complex installation you've personally led from kickoff to closeout?

2\. Tell us about a job you ran where you had a sub crew or another tech working alongside you.

3\. What's your availability to start?

4\. This role splits between running installs and working our support queue day to day, and the mix shifts week to week. Tell us about a time you kept a ticket queue and project work moving at the same time — what did that week actually look like?

**Optional, but we'd genuinely like to see it:** attach a few photos of work you've done — a rack you built, a cable run you dressed, a finished install you're happy with. Phone photos are fine; nothing polished required. Please make sure anything you send doesn't identify a client or expose their network details.

No generic cover letters needed. Just be real.

**Note:** This role requires signing an employment agreement that includes confidentiality terms. You'll have direct access to client networks, systems, and facilities.

Pay: $35\.00 \- $47\.00 per hour

Benefits:

* On\-the\-job training
* Opportunities for advancement
* Paid time off
* Paid training

eyesAtop is building the operating platform for multi\-drone warfare, a battle\-proven system that augments, deploys, and orchestrates autonomous drone fleets across any mission, any environment, and any vendor. Our software flies drones in combat. The Android control app is the operator's window into the battlefield: it is how a single person commands a fleet of drones in real time, under pressure, in the field. We are looking for an Android Application Engineer to own that interface end to end.

This is not a consumer app. Every design decision carries operational weight. The UI must surface the right information at the right moment, respond instantly under degraded conditions, and never fail when it matters. You will work directly with pilots and operators, translate field feedback into product decisions, and own the application from architecture through deployment.

**WHAT YOU'LL DO**

* Own the eyesAtop Android control application: architecture, development, performance, and reliability
* Build real\-time UIs that display live drone telemetry, video feeds, map overlays, and fleet status simultaneously
* Design and implement operator workflows for commanding autonomous drone fleets in high\-stakes, low\-margin\-for\-error environments
* Manage real\-time data streams over UDP/TCP, WebSockets, and custom protocols between the app and backend services
* Optimize for responsiveness and stability on ruggedized Android hardware used in the field
* Handle connectivity\-degraded scenarios gracefully: offline modes, reconnection logic, and partial state recovery
* Work closely with pilots and operators to translate field feedback into product decisions
* Collaborate with backend and integration engineers to define and consume APIs

**REQUIREMENTS**

* 3\+ years of professional Android development in Kotlin and/or Java
* Strong understanding of Android architecture patterns (MVVM, clean architecture), lifecycle management, and background processing
* Experience with real\-time data rendering: maps, video, and live telemetry visualizations
* Solid grasp of networking fundamentals: sockets, HTTP APIs, WebSockets, and serialization
* Comfort with performance profiling, memory management, and on\-device debugging
* Ability to reason about UX in high\-stress, heads\-down operational contexts; reliability and clarity over aesthetics

**STRONG FIT IF**

* You've worked with drone vendor SDKs (DJI, Autel, or similar) or built abstraction layers over hardware APIs
* You've built apps that display real\-time geo and map data: drone tracks, routes, areas of interest
* You have experience with video streaming (RTSP, WebRTC, or similar) in mobile applications

title: Systems Engineer, Robotics Integration
description:
**ABOUT EYESATOP**

eyesAtop is building the operating platform for multi\-drone warfare, a battle\-proven system that augments, deploys, and orchestrates autonomous drone fleets across any mission, any environment, and any vendor. With over 500,000 hours of frontline operational use and TRL\-9 validation, our software is not a prototype. It runs in combat, every day, shaping outcomes in some of the most contested and complex environments on earth.

At the core of our platform is a unique combination of hardware, software, and open edge\-AI: a drone\-agnostic universal controller, edge compute units that bring AI processing to the battlefield, and an open architecture that enables rapid integration of new platforms and payloads without disrupting live operations. Our systems operate in GNSS denied, EW\-contested environments; they must work, every time, without fail.

We are expanding our US engineering team in the New York metropolitan area. Our office is easily accessible from New York City. If you want to build hardware and software that has direct, measurable impact in the field, this is the role for you.

**THE ROLE**

We are looking for a Systems Engineer with a strong hybrid profile, equally comfortable designing a PCB schematic and writing embedded firmware, to own the full integration lifecycle of drones, robotics platforms, and third\-party systems into the eyesAtop platform.

This is a hands\-on, end\-to\-end role at the intersection of hardware and software. You will design electronics and circuits where needed, write the embedded code that makes systems talk, integrate third\-party payloads and sensors, work directly with drone OEMs and component vendors, and validate everything in lab, simulation, and field environments. You won't just connect systems; you'll own them from first bring\-up to deployed capability.

**WHAT YOU'LL DO**

* Lead the integration of drone platforms, robotics systems, sensors, payloads, and third\-party hardware into the eyesAtop platform ecosystem
* Design hardware solutions: schematics, PCB layouts, power systems, and signal conditioning circuits, to support new integrations and custom interface requirements
* Write embedded firmware and low\-level software to enable communication between hardware components, flight controllers, and the eyesAtop C2 layer
* Develop integration scripts, test harnesses, and automated validation tools to verify system reliability across platforms and configurations
* Interface directly with drone OEMs, hardware vendors, and payload manufacturers, evaluating components, managing supplier relationships, and resolving technical issues under field conditions
* Debug complex, cross\-domain issues spanning electronics, firmware, networking, communication protocols, and operator workflows
* Define and execute hardware\-in\-the\-loop (HIL) and system\-level test plans in lab, simulation, and real\-world flight environments
* Build and maintain integration infrastructure, tooling, build processes, and documentation that scale as the platform and drone fleet expand
* Collaborate closely with software, mechanical, and product teams to translate operational requirements into reliable, field\-ready capabilities

**REQUIREMENTS**

* B.Sc. in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Mechatronics, or equivalent practical experience
* 3\+ years of experience in systems engineering, embedded systems, or hardware/software integration in a production environment
* Solid hardware fundamentals: schematic capture, PCB design, power electronics, and signal integrity, capable of designing and reviewing circuits independently
* Hands\-on embedded software experience: C/C\+\+ firmware, RTOS concepts, device drivers, and board bring\-up
* Experience with hardware communication protocols: UART, SPI, I2C, CAN bus, USB, Ethernet, or similar
* Comfortable with Linux as both a development and deployment environment; able to write Python scripts for test automation, data parsing, and hardware control
* Experience integrating sensors, actuators, cameras, or radio systems into robotic or autonomous platforms
* Strong debugging skills across the full stack: oscilloscope, logic analyzer, protocol sniffer, GDB

**STRONG FIT IF**

* You have experience with drones, UAVs, or autonomous robotic systems, in defense, industrial, or field\-tested environments
* You've worked with embedded platforms such as STM32, ESP32, NVIDIA Jetson, Pixhawk, or similar
* You've led end\-to\-end integrations from first hardware bring\-up through field validation and production release
* You have experience with RF systems, wireless communication protocols, or video telemetry links used in UAS
* You've used ECAD tools (KiCad, Altium, or equivalent) and have shipped PCB designs to production
* You're comfortable with MAVLink, ROS, or similar robotics/drone middleware
* You've managed hardware vendor or drone OEM relationships under tight timelines

Pay: $180,000\.00 \- $220,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Paid time off
* Vision insurance

Application Question(s):

* Describe a hardware/software integration you personally owned from initial circuit or PCB design through firmware development, system bring\-up, and field validation. What were your specific responsibilities?
* Tell us about a difficult embedded\-system failure you diagnosed. What symptoms did you observe, which tools did you use, and what was the root cause?

title: Medium Voltage Electrician (Construction)
description:
SpaceXAI's mission is to create AI systems that can accurately understand the universe and aid humanity in its pursuit of knowledge. Our team is small, highly motivated, and focused on engineering excellence. This organization is for individuals who appreciate challenging themselves and thrive on curiosity. We operate with a flat organizational structure. All employees are expected to be hands\-on and to contribute directly to the company's mission. Leadership is given to those who show initiative and consistently deliver excellence. Work ethic and strong prioritization skills are important. All employees are expected to have strong communication skills. They should be able to concisely and accurately share knowledge with their teammates.

**ABOUT THE ROLE**



We are hiring skilled Electricians to join SpaceXAI's internal construction and electrical teams supporting the rapid build\-out of our data centers. This is a traveling role—you will mobilize with project teams to active construction sites, install and commission mission\-critical electrical systems, and move with the work as new facilities come online.



You will work on high\-voltage and medium\-voltage power distribution, backup power systems, grounding, lighting, and process power in a fast\-paced, high\-stakes environment where uptime and safety are paramount. This hands\-on position is ideal for experienced electricians who thrive in industrial or data\-center settings, enjoy project\-based travel, and want to contribute directly to groundbreaking AI infrastructure.


**RESPONSIBILITIES**


* Travel with internal construction and electrical teams to project sites to install, terminate, and test electrical systems including underground duct banks, conduits, cable pulling, switchgear, transformers, generators, UPS systems, PDUs, busways, and grounding.
* Perform maintenance, troubleshooting, and repairs on low\- and medium\-voltage power distribution systems across multiple active sites.
* Support commissioning activities: point\-to\-point checks, functional testing, megger testing, and system energization.
* Read and interpret electrical drawings, schematics, one\-line diagrams, and specifications.
* Ensure full compliance with NEC, NFPA 70E, OSHA, and SpaceXAI safety \& quality standards (including LOTO and arc flash protocols).
* Collaborate with contractors, engineers, and operations teams to deliver projects on time with zero incidents.
* Participate in constructibility reviews and provide field feedback to improve designs.
* Maintain accurate documentation, as\-builts, and test records.
* Mobilize quickly between project locations as construction phases and priorities shift.


**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**


* 2\+ years of hands\-on experience in industrial, commercial, or mission\-critical electrical work (data centers, power plants, or large facilities preferred).
* Strong knowledge of electrical systems up to 480V (medium/high voltage experience a big plus).
* Proficiency with test equipment (multimeters, meggers, power quality analyzers, etc.).
* Ability to read blueprints and electrical diagrams.
* Current OSHA 10/30 training and strong safety mindset.
* Willingness and ability to travel extensively (often 80–100%) and work flexible hours, including nights, weekends, and extended shifts during critical builds or commissioning.
* Ability to lift 50\+ lbs, climb ladders, and work in industrial environments with PPE.


**PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE**


* Journeyman Electrician license (or equivalent).
* Experience with data center or hyperscale power infrastructure (redundant UPS, generators, busway systems).
* Prior work on large\-scale, multi\-site construction projects that required frequent travel.
* NETA certification, NICET, or equivalent.
* Knowledge of PLC/controls, SCADA, or variable frequency drives.

*SpaceXAI is an equal opportunity employer. For details on data processing, view our* *Recruitment Privacy Notice**.*

Astrocade is an AI technology company building super\-intelligence for the interactive world, delivered through a breakout consumer platform.


Today's frontier models can write, reason, and generate video. None can build a world you can step into and act on. Interactive world models are one of the defining problems on the path to ASI, and the foundation of the next great consumer platform. Interactivity is the holy grail of content: not something you watch, but something that responds to you. We're further ahead than anyone: the only team building the intelligence and the platform together, and both are already live.


Our social UGC platform lets anyone create and play interactive experiences through natural language. And it's one of the fastest\-growing consumer products in the world, with over 30 million users in just months since launch. Creators bring to life games, companions that remember and grow with them, learning experiences that adapt like a great tutor, and social worlds built with friends. The platform also powers our research with data no video dataset contains: millions of creators prompting and refining gives us paired data of human intent and the worlds that fulfill it, and every play session produces ground\-truth, action\-labeled interaction data at scale. All of it flows back into our models, and research ships to real players in days, spinning a flywheel no one else can build.


We are a small team from Google Research, Meta, FAIR, Character.ai, and Stanford, led alongside Fei\-Fei Li, with frontier\-scale compute and direct ownership of core model problems. We are backed by Sequoia Capital, Google, NVIDIA, and luminaries including Eric Schmidt and Jerry Yang.

The best consumer products aren't built by handing specs across a wall, they're built by people who own the problem end\-to\-end. description:
**About Soulside**
------------------


Soulside AI is an enterprise AI platform built specifically for behavioral health. We automate clinical documentation, chart audits, and RCM processes so treatment organizations can protect clinician capacity, stay audit\-ready, and capture the revenue their care already earns. Our platform cuts documentation time by more than 80%, achieves near\-universal voluntary clinician adoption, and solves the hardest problem in behavioral health AI: fully automated group session documentation with individualized notes for every participant.


We serve a growing portfolio of behavioral health organizations across the full continuum of care, from residential and PHP/IOP programs to outpatient, community mental health, substance use, and eating disorder treatment, and we integrate with the EHRs our clients already use. We are growing fast, and the client success function is where our product promises become client reality.

**The Role**

You will own the day\-to\-day operational engine of our client portfolio: running implementations, delivering training, triaging support, and keeping every cross\-team commitment tracked to closure. You are the reason clients feel taken care of every single day, and the reason nothing falls through the cracks as we scale.


This is a high\-ownership role at an early\-stage company. You will work directly with the Director of Client Success, with a direct line to engineering, and what you do here becomes the playbook for the CS function as it grows.

Above everything else, you care about our clients and the work they do. They are treating people at the hardest moments of their lives, and you never lose sight of the fact that every ticket, every training, and every template exists in service of that. If that doesn't move you, this isn't your role.


You are hungry. You want more ownership than most jobs will give you, and when you commit to something, it gets done without anyone checking. You are amazing with people: clinicians, executives, and engineers all trust you quickly, and you can read a room, calm a frustrated user, and hold your own in a technical conversation in the same afternoon. You genuinely love software and technology: learning a new tool, tightening a workflow, digging into product details, and finding creative solutions to problems that don't have a playbook yet. You bring a point of view instead of waiting for direction, and you anticipate what a client will need before they ask. Breadth energizes you: running a training in the morning, untangling a workflow question at noon, and closing out a ticket queue by end of day is your kind of day. Solstice is redefining how life sciences organizations commercialize their therapeutics. We are building a commercial engine that allows pharmaceutical marketers to launch campaigns at 100x the speed.

Building anything great requires commitment and dedication. We are looking for someone who wants to take real ownership of a difficult, consequential data problem.

**About the role**


We are hiring our first data engineer to build the data foundation for Solstice's media activation and measurement products. Our long\-term goal is to close the loop between the content we create, the audiences who see it, and the outcomes it drives, then use that evidence to make the next campaign better.


Doing that requires reliable data across systems that were not designed to work together. Media partners and publishers produce daily delivery logs in different formats. Identifiers need to be reconciled back to healthcare professionals, campaigns, audiences, assets, and individual creative elements. Data arrives late, changes shape, contains duplicates, and includes off\-list or unmatched records that cannot simply be dropped.


You will own this foundation end to end: the cloud warehouse, ingestion and transformation pipelines, identity and attribution mappings, data quality, observability, and the interfaces that make trusted data usable by our product, media, and AI teams. This is not a reporting or dashboard\-only role. You will build the production systems that make measurement and learning possible.

**What you'll be working on**

* Design, build, and operate the cloud data platform for Solstice's media products, from raw partner data through trusted, analysis\-ready models.
* Ingest daily event and delivery logs from DSPs, publishers, claims\-data providers, client systems, and Solstice's own content platform.
* Build durable mappings across vendor identifiers, NPIs, campaigns, audiences, assets, and atomic creative elements.
* Handle the hard cases in third\-party data: de\-aggregation, off\-list records, unmatched identities, duplicates, late\-arriving data, schema drift, and backfills.
* Create canonical data models that connect creative attributes and exposures to clicks, engagement, and longer\-lag outcomes such as prescription or claims signals.
* Build reliable batch and event\-driven pipelines with clear lineage, idempotent processing, automated data\-quality checks, and actionable alerting.
* Make partner integrations repeatable, including APIs, secure file transfer, validation, reconciliation, and audit trails.
* Provide clean datasets and services that support campaign measurement, experimentation, attribution, and the creative\-to\-performance feedback loop.
* Own the reliability, security, and cost of the data platform as volume and the number of partners grow.
* Work directly with media, product, AI, and customer teams to launch the first campaigns, investigate discrepancies, and turn real operating problems into durable platform capabilities.

**What we're looking for**

*Must\-haves*

* Strong Python and SQL, with experience building and operating production data systems.
* Deep experience with ETL or ELT pipelines, data modeling, workflow orchestration, and a modern cloud warehouse or lakehouse.
* Experience ingesting messy third\-party data and reconciling records across systems with inconsistent identifiers and schemas.
* Strong instincts for data correctness: validation, lineage, observability, backfills, deduplication, and failure recovery.
* Experience designing systems that are reliable under growing volume, changing partner contracts, and imperfect upstream inputs.
* Independent judgment and end\-to\-end ownership. You can turn an ambiguous business goal into a technical plan, ship it, and operate it.
* Clear communication. You can explain data quality and measurement tradeoffs to technical and non\-technical partners, and you are comfortable working directly with external vendors.
* A high bar for craft, urgency, and follow\-through.

*Strongly preferred*

* Experience with GCP and BigQuery, or comparable depth with AWS, Azure, Snowflake, Databricks, or Redshift.
* Experience with data transformation and orchestration tools such as dbt, Airflow, Dagster, or Prefect.
* Experience in adtech, media delivery, measurement, attribution, or marketing data platforms.
* Familiarity with healthcare or life sciences data, including NPI\-keyed HCP data, claims, or prescription signals.
* Experience building secure data systems for regulated, privacy\-sensitive, or enterprise environments.
* Experience preparing high\-quality data for experimentation, analytics, machine learning, or AI systems.

*Bonus points*

* Experience integrating with DSPs, endemic publishers, identity vendors, or claims\-data providers.
* Familiarity with creative\-level or component\-level measurement, incrementality, or experiment design.
* Experience building a data platform from zero to one at an early\-stage company.

**Benefits**

* Health, dental, and vision insurance
* Ground\-floor equity opportunity
* Unlimited PTO
* 401(k) Match
* Visa sponsorship (O\-1, H\-1B, TN) available
* Work in a high\-velocity, high\-impact environment

**Competitive NYC compensation**


This role offers a highly competitive NYC salary in the $200,000 to $300,000 range, calibrated to reflect experience, seniority, and the level of ownership you will take on as part of the early team. We benchmark against top\-tier startups and established technology companies to ensure our compensation is fair and compelling, with flexibility at the upper end for exceptional candidates who can materially accelerate our data platform and media roadmap.

title: AI Integration & Automation Engineer
description:

This is a builder\-first, hands\-on\-keyboard role. You should know how to code rapidly prototyping and shipping working applications with AI coding tools rather than writing everything from scratch while still knowing enough to secure, maintain, and version\-control what you build (using GitHub as the backbone for all code and configuration). You'll be fluent across multiple AI platforms and vendors, know which tool fits which job, and be comfortable owning something from idea to internal production use.

**Key Responsibilities**


AI Application \& Agent Development

* Build internal applications, tools, and AI agents using a multi\-vendor stack Claude, GitHub (Copilot and Actions), Lovable, ChatGPT, and others deliberately avoiding lock\-in to any single provider and combining tools to fit each use case.

* Use GitHub as the backbone for version control, code review, and CI/CD across every application and integration built regardless of which AI platform generated the original code.

Data Infrastructure \& Secure Connections

* Build and maintain secure, reliable connections between the DMS, CRM, and Mauer's internal data lake, so data from every store flows into one governed source.
* Structure and maintain the data lake so it's usable as a foundation for AI\-built applications and agents clean schemas, reliable pipelines, sensible access boundaries.
* Ensure all data connections (DMS \- CRM \- data lake \- AI tools) are encrypted, access\-controlled, and monitored for reliability and integrity.


Automation \& Integration Development

* Design and build automation workflows (Zapier, Make, Power Automate, or custom scripts) and AI agents that connect systems across the group leads, inventory, service scheduling, follow\-up communications, F\&I, and marketing platforms.
* Build and maintain API integrations between the DMS/CRM, the internal data lake, and third\-party AI tools, ensuring data flows cleanly and reliably in all directions.
* Write and maintain scripts and small applications (Python, JavaScript, SQL) for data pulls, reporting, custom connectors, and process automation.
* Develop internal tools, dashboards, and reports built on the data lake to support store managers and leadership.
* Troubleshoot broken integrations, agents, and automations across the store network, diagnosing root cause (API changes, data mismatches, tool updates) and fixing quickly to minimize downtime.


AI Tool Lifecycle: Build, Replace \& Maintain

* Own the ongoing health of the group's AI application, agent, and tool stack across vendors (Claude, GitHub, ChatGPT, Lovable, and others) monitor performance, uptime, and output quality.
* Proactively evaluate the market across multiple vendors for better\-fit AI tools and platforms, and lead migrations when an existing tool is underperforming, outdated, or being replaced by something stronger deliberately keeping the group multi\-vendor rather than locked into one provider.

We are a team of data scientists, software engineers, researchers, product developers, and operation\-minded folks who specialize in developing applications and products that our customers love. Our mission is to reinvent the way technical and non\-technical people work with technology. We believe in creating harmonious, automated solutions designed to improve our customers’ daily workflow, allowing them to act quickly and decisively about what matters most. We are looking for critical thinkers who excel at solving problems and have a passion for what they do to help us move our mission forward. This is our story; come tell us yours.

  

At TeamWorx Security, Inc., we hold our values as guiding principles in all that we do and encourage our community to embrace and embody them. Our core values are **putting our people first**, **being curious**, **being authentic**, **being scrappy**, and **honoring those who serve**. These values drive our company culture, decision\-making, and operations.
